summary: Feed s080_single to APM is degraded: 28.2% duplicate packets (670/2372) exceeds 5% threshold. All other checks (one-way traffic, packet drops, VLAN completeness, encrypted share, tool overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is aggregating the same traffic from multiple SPAN/TAP sources without deduplication. The same packets arriving via redundant paths or overlapping SPAN sessions are merged and forwarded twice to the APM port.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM will double-count transactions and flows, inflate throughput and latency metrics, waste CPU/storage on duplicate processing, and generate inaccurate application performance baselines and false alerts.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet-broker deduplication with a short window to drop identical packets before delivery to the 10G APM, eliminating 28% duplicates while preserving complete bidirectional visibility.
